# Galore Labs

> Galore Labs is a deliberately small, deliberately senior AI-native consulting firm based in Bengaluru, India, working across two integrated practices: Technology Strategy and Marketing & Growth. Every engagement is led directly by a partner with 13+ years of experience; AI handles repetitive execution so partners can go deeper with fewer clients rather than spreading thin.

## Services

- Technology: AI & automation, cloud strategy, DevOps-led digital transformation, cybersecurity & compliance.
- Marketing & Growth: brand strategy & development, content marketing, social media management, paid advertising, go-to-market planning.

## Leadership

- Uday T. Kumar — Managing Partner, Technology. Formerly Yellow.AI, Zeta, EY. 20+ years leading DevOps and cloud-based digital transformation.
- Ru Chatterji — Partner, Growth & Marketing. Formerly Peepul Tree, Tanishq.

## Industries served

FinTech, BFSI, Telecom, SaaS, Lifestyle.
